setting: Cairngorms, winter, last light. We are sitting at the team's base radio.

BASE.name: WTPN D-hector
BASE.note: middle-aged Scottish male, base controller. Steadier model: v3 drifted his accent between lines

EWAN.name: Ally - Soft Scottish Glaswegian
EWAN.note: late 20s Scottish male, ahead on the ridge

CAT.name: WTPN Isla - Scottish

lines.text: —ver the crest now. Visibility's shocking, maybe ten metres. Keep off the edge on your left, it's a long way down.
lines.say: Over the crest now. Visibility's shocking, maybe ten metres. Keep off the edge on your left, it's a long way down.

lines.text: Aye, roger. I cannae see you at all.
I'm thirty metres ahead of you. Just keep coming.
Base, roger. Ewan, give me your position when you can.
Base, Ewan — nine seven five, oh three five. On the crest, heading east.
Base — standby.
Base, I've found someone. He's sat against a rock, out of the wind, ten metres off the path. No jacket.
Say again — no jacket?
No jacket, no bag, nothing. He's soaking wet.
Ewan, there's no one else up there tonight. Nobody's been reported missing.
Well, he's here.
Hello? Mate? Can you hear me?
Hello — can you hear my voice?
Base, he's not shivering.
Say again, Ewan.
He's not shivering. He should be shivering.
Base. He's wearing our kit.
Ewan—
He's wearing my jacket. Base, he's got my— he's got my face, he's got my fac—
Ewan! Oh, there you are, you absolute clown, I've been shouting myself hoarse—
Cat. Cat, that's not me. That is not—
What? You're stood right in front of—
Don't let it—
Cat. Ewan. Radio check, over.
Base, this is Ewan. All fine. We're coming down.

notes.payoff: l25 is the only hill transmission with no wind behind it. That is the whole video.
